So 2026-01-01 is Thursday. Then 2026-10-16: from Jan 1 to Oct 16 is 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+16 = 279 days? So 289 days after Jan 1. 289 mod 7 = 289-280=9, 9 mod 7 = 2. So day of week: Thursday + 2 days = Saturday. So 2026-10-16 is Saturday. Next Friday would be 2026-10-21?
